title: Chapter 637 - 637 Meeting Wang Fengyi; Unsealing!
content:
Chapter 637 - 637 Meeting Wang Fengyi; Unsealing!

Chapter 637 - 637 Meeting Wang Fengyi; Unsealing!

637 Meeting Wang Fengyi; Unsealing!

The share price plunged by 20%!

Shunli Express, Wanjia Group, Hengfeng Group… These were all very large enterprises, and many of them had close cooperative relations with Dafang Group.

Now, they had all canceled their cooperation?

This was definitely not a small loss for the Dafang Group.

In fact, the loss was much greater than what it appeared to be on the surface.

With so many big companies breaking off their cooperation at the same time, it might cause some kind of chain reaction. This was the most terrifying thing.

The World Bank had also stopped lending them money!

Although Dafang Group had a huge business, its cash flow was still relatively limited.

Most of the raw materials, labor, bases, and so on were all dependent on the World Bank’s huge loans.

Now, the World Bank had suddenly stopped lending them money. It was as if the Dafang Group had been strangled by the neck, making them completely unable to breathe.

The company’s taxes would also be investigated.

A thorough investigation of taxes was a very normal thing to do.

This was the law that all companies should abide by.

There would be a review at least once a year.

In the past, Fang Lei did not pay much attention to it.

But today, he was extremely flustered.

This was because there was indeed a problem with his taxes, a deeply hidden problem.

Fang Lei had a very bad feeling. Perhaps, they would find something wrong after checking.

And once the problem was discovered, then…

A thin layer of sweat gradually appeared on Fang Lei’s forehead.

Then, he quickly made another call.

A moment later, the call was finally connected.

“Boss He…” Fang Lei said.

However, before he could finish, a low voice sounded from the other end.

“Fang Lei, what have you done?”

“Damn it! Now, the Wang family, the ancient Zhang family, the richest Ma family, and the giant Ran family… have all issued a ban on you!

“In this kind of situation, you still called me! Are you trying to drag me down with you?”

After saying that, he abruptly hung up the phone.

A hurried busy tone echoed in Fang Lei’s ears.

He was completely stunned.

The Wang family, the Zhang family, the Ma family, and the Ran family… Which one of them was not a terrifying existence like a giant?

They were all targets that he looked up to.

In the end, they all issued a ban on him?

Fang Lei’s face turned pale. He was panicking and terrified to the extreme.

It was over!

Dafang Group was finished!

The Fang family was finished!

But why?!

At this moment, Li Weiwen shouted, “What’s going on? Say something! When will you avenge your son? You’ve been standing there like a fool!”

Revenge for his son?

Son?

Imperial Hotel?

That young man?

At this moment, Fang Lei suddenly connected everything together.

It was him!

It was him!

All of this was caused by him!

Fang Lei’s entire body was burning with rage at the thought of this.

“What are you shouting for?” Fang Lei shouted sternly. “It’s all your fault for spoiling him like this!”

Then, he kicked Fang Wenjie in the stomach and shouted, “Bastard!”

“Ah!”

Immediately, a series of miserable howls rang out in the luxurious villa.

…

Lin Fan was completely oblivious to all of this.

At this moment, he had already arrived at the luxurious presidential suite of the Imperial Hotel.

Taking advantage of the time when the bathtub was filling up with hot water, he moved his mind slightly and the space shook.

In the next moment, Lin Fan appeared at Jiangbei University.

At this moment, a black watch was shining.

When Lin Fan appeared, the black watch let out a cheerful sound.

“Master, I finally get to see you again.”

It was the super smart watch Little White.

“Sorry for the long wait,” said Lin Fan.

As soon as he finished speaking, Lin Fan picked up Little White and put it back on his wrist.

Then, the surrounding space shook slightly.

In the next moment, Lin Fan returned to the luxurious presidential suite of the Imperial Hotel.

At this moment…

The spacious bathtub was filled with water.

The air was filled with a pleasant fragrance.

Lin Fan took off his clothes and lay in the bathtub. His face revealed a relaxed and content expression that had not been seen in a long time.

Most people would only stay in the bathtub for half an hour at most.

After half an hour, their skin would wrinkle or the hot water would turn cold.

However, Lin Fan’s physique was far superior to normal people. Naturally, he was not worried about his skin getting wrinkled.

Moreover, he also had Perfect Water Control Technique.

There was no need to worry about the hot water becoming cold either.

That was because Lin Fan had Perfect Fire Control Technique. With a single thought, he could heat the water to any temperature.

Lin Fan stayed in the bathtub for a full two hours before he slowly climbed out.

Then, he lay down on the soft bed that he had not seen for a long time and fell asleep.

…

In the blink of an eye, it was the second day.

When Lin Fan pushed open the door of the luxurious suite, there was already a waiter waiting at the door.

“Mr. Lin, do you wish to have breakfast now?” he asked respectfully.”

“Yes,” Lin Fan said.

“Got it,” the waiter said.

Not long after, Flying Gold Sparrow Bun, Pan-Fried Red Beef, Golden Pancake, Pearl Meat, and Silky Soup were served…

All the food was made from exotic beasts and plants. Coupled with the meticulous cooking of top-notch chefs, every dish was incomparably delicious.

After eating, Lin Fan nodded his head in satisfaction and said, “Not bad.”

At this moment, someone knocked on the door.

“Come in,” Lin Fan said.

Then, Wang Zhihai, Wang Qianjin, Wang You, and the others all bowed and walked in respectfully.
